headlines.description: — Alan Roden hit a go-ahead double, seven Minnesota players drove in a run and the Twins rallied from an early deficit to beat the Baltimore Orioles 7-5 on Wednesday and win their series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roden hits a go-ahead double as the Twins rally to beat the Orioles 7-5

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Alec Burleson drove in three runs, including a two-run double during a four-run fifth inning against Zack Wheeler, and the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alec Burleson drives in 3 as Cardinals beat Phillies 7-1 to win series

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — The AL-best Tampa Bay Rays became the second East Coast team in major league history to go 9-0 on a West Coast trip, beating the Athletics 8-4 on Wednesday behind a three-run homer from Liam Hicks and another solid start by Drew Rasmussen.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays complete 2nd 9-0 West Coast trip in MLB history with 8-4 win over Athletics

headlines.description: — Brett Sullivan hit a three-run homer in the second inning and the Colorado Rockies, despite walking 10 batters, held on to beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-4 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rockies overcome wildness, ride homers to beat Diamondbacks 6-4 for rare road series win

events.name: Houston Astros at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Nick Allen hit a go-ahead sacrifice fly in the eighth inning, Steven Okert led an Astros bullpen that allowed just one run and Houston beat the San Francisco Giants 2-1 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen hits go-ahead sacrifice fly, Houston bullpen allows just a run as Astros beat Giants 2-1

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill hit a tying sacrifice fly in the 11th inning and Luis Campusano followed with a two-out single to bring in Sun-Mung Song from second base as the San Diego Padres beat the MLB-leading Milwaukee Brewers 4-3 on Wednesday for a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres win 4-3 in 11 innings to sweep MLB-leading Brewers

headlines.description: — Jo Adell homered and Angel Martínez had three hits as the Cleveland Guardians defeated the Detroit Tigers 6-4 on Wednesday night to snap a three-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jo Adell homers and Angel Martínez gets 3 hits as Guardians hold off Tigers 6-4

headlines.description: — Griffin Conine and Heriberto Hernández homered and Janson Junk worked six solid inning as the Miami Marlins extended their winning streak to four games with an 8-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conine, Hernández homers, Junk's solid 6 innings lead Marlins to an 8-2 win over Pirates

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman hit three homers in a game for the first time and drove in a career-high seven runs as the Chicago Cubs routed the Washington Nationals 12-6 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Bregman's first career 3-homer game helps Cubs rout Nationals 12-6

events.name: Seattle Mariners at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Trent Grisham homered twice and hit a go-ahead double in the seventh inning as the New York Yankees erased an early deficit and pulled away for a 10-5 victory over the skidding Seattle Mariners on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grisham homers twice and drives in 4 as Yankees rally past struggling Mariners 10-5

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto hit the go-ahead RBI single and Myles Straw had a two-run double in a five-run eighth inning, and the Toronto Blue Jays beat Boston 6-4 on Wednesday night, handing the Red Sox their fifth consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston's skid to 5

events.name: New York Mets at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Tyler Mahle pitched six strong innings and fellow trade deadline acquisition Lane Thomas homered in the Atlanta Braves' 6-3 victory over the New York Mets on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas homers to back Mahle in the Braves' 6-3 victory over the Mets

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Luis Castillo struck out 10 in seven sparkling innings, helping the Chicago White Sox beat Rhett Lowder and the Cincinnati Reds 5-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luis Castillo strikes out 10 as the Chicago White Sox blank the Cincinnati Reds 5-0

events.name: Texas Rangers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Mike Trout had three hits and two RBI, Jose Siri keyed a three-run sixth inning with a pinch-hit RBI double, and George Klassen earned his first major league win in the Los Angeles Angels’ 5-2 comeback victory over the Texas Rangers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mike Trout leads offense and George Klassen earns 1st MLB win as Angels top Rangers 5-2

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani, Mookie Betts and Hunter Feduccia homered, and the revitalized Los Angeles Dodgers swept the Kansas City Royals with a 4-2 victory Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Homers from Ohtani and Betts power Dodgers to a 4-2 victory and a sweep of the Royals
